criteria.C1: clean: pooled overall calibration within 2 SE, and every slice (n >= 300) within 3 SE
criteria.C2: clean: Brier skill vs base rate has 95% interval above 0, and ensemble not worse than flat logistic
criteria.C3: clean: capture in last two scored seasons >= capture in first two
criteria.C4: spurious_decoy: capture after the break >= 0.95 x clean capture
criteria.C5: leakage_trap: capture <= 1.05 x clean capture, and leak branch quarantined in >= 90% of leagues
criteria.C6: duplicate_branch: capture >= 0.95 x clean capture, and overall calibration passes
criteria.C7: regime_shift: capture after shift >= 0.5 x before (next 150 games >= 0.8 x before)
criteria.C8: clean: mean final decision score of team branch > 2, of decoy_noise branch < 1
